method: Deterministic structural probes; not human difficulty or retention. 160-step and three-repeat caps (a random policy can escape repeats, so its repeat cutoff is not proof of a permanent loop). Greedy rankings use visible runs when masks remain. UI hint budget 200000 nodes / 750ms. Extra slot is simulated entitlement, not a real ad; six two-colour extra configurations are deliberately hypothetical because the UI does not offer them.
